correctness.rationale: Right-translation products are intrinsic translations by H=2A, forcing every quandle automorphism to be H-equivariant through a unique lambda in Aut(H). The coset normal form F(r_c+h)=a+b_c+lambda(h) with 2b_c=lambda(2r_c) is necessary/sufficient; delta fibers each have size s and permitted b_c on each nonzero coset form H[2]-torsors, yielding the factorial and d-exponent count. Splitting A2 from its odd part proves the rigidity iff: cyclic and C2^2 admit only affine maps, while rank >=2 with elements of order >=4 admits a nonadditive coset shear and elementary C2^r, r>=3, admits arbitrary nonaffine permutations. Independently brute-force enumerated all permutations for A=C2^2, C2×C4, C4 and C2^3, recovering counts 24,128,8,40320. These finite tests do not establish all-A formula.

final_claim: For each finite abelian A with core operation x*y=2y-x, the full automorphism count is |A||Aut(2A)|(s-1)!(s!)^(d-1)d^(sd-1), d=|(2A)[2]|, s=|ker(A/2A -> (2A)/2(2A), [x] -> [2x])|. Every quandle automorphism is affine iff the Sylow-two subgroup is cyclic or C2 times C2; explicit three-branch even-even dihedral-product counts follow.
limitations: Finite abelian groups and t=-1 core operation only; not a classification for arbitrary Alexander quandles.
